subject: english
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The Government has been building more schools to __provided education at__ the secondary level.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Provide education at.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The correct substitution for the underlined phrase is "provide education at".

The preposition 'to' is followed by the first form of the verb.

Thus, 'to' will be followed by 'provide' and not 'provided'.

The correct preposition to use after education is 'at'.

Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

Correct Sentence: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The word** "at"** has multiple meanings and can be used in various contexts. Here are some common meanings of "at" with example usages:
 
• **Location:** "At" can indicate a specific location or position.
 
 
• She is waiting **at **the bus stop.
 
 
 
• **Time:** "At" can indicate a specific time or moment.
 
 
• The meeting starts **at **9 a.m.
 
 
 
• **Direction or Movement:** "At" can indicate a direction or movement towards a specific place.
 
 
• He threw the ball **at** the target.
 
 
 
• **Purpose or Function: **"At" can indicate the purpose or function of something.
 
 
• She excels **at **playing the piano.
 
 
 
• **Price or Rate:** "At" can indicate a price or rate.
 
 
• The item is available **at **$50.
 
 
 
• **Involvement or Participation:** "At" can indicate involvement or participation in an activity or event.
 
 
• He was present **at **the meeting.
